mechanism: Efavirenz may increase chlorthalidone metabolism via CYP3A4 induction while chlorthalidone can cause hypokalemia and metabolic effects that may be exacerbated by efavirenz-induced CNS and metabolic effects.
action: Monitor electrolytes (particularly potassium) and blood pressure regularly; consider alternative antihypertensive if significant hypokalemia develops; counsel on orthostatic hypotension risk.
